title: AcDs modeler ownership-transfer callback fast slice
mode: local implementation and focused fast verification
owner: PAR-07 / S8.3 / 7S.3 / DWG modeler callback staging
scope: Avoid deep-copying completed DWG REGION/3DSOLID/BODY values into journal events and then into the in-tree dwg2dxf block model
Preserve the existing const-reference callback for current consumers and verify move dispatch on generated AC1027 inputs

changes: Added a trailing, non-pure DRW_Interface rvalue callback that forwards to the existing const-reference callback by default; existing consumer source implementations need not add an override.
Added a single-delivery owned modeler event and changed the REGION, 3DSOLID, and BODY dispatch paths to move parsed entities into it.
Materialized each paired DRW_UnsupportedObject raw view from the complete parsed entity before moving the typed value, preserving common-link flags and reactor vectors.

Changed the in-tree dx_iface adapter to move the completed modeler entity into its block storage; legacy const-reference consumers continue to receive the callback through the default forwarding implementation.

Extended generated dispatch tests to verify move-callback delivery, paired raw-view identity/owner/reactor/AcDs/frame state, an exact two-page AcDs payload, and default forwarding to a legacy const-reference override.
implementation.copyBoundary: Removes the journal-event deep copy and in-tree adapter deep copy for the selected typed modeler entity. The paired raw callback remains independently materialized. The separately budgeted DataStorage-record-to-entity payload copy, arbitrary consumer copies, allocator overhead, and process RSS are unchanged and out of scope.
implementation.compatibility: The new virtual is trailing and non-pure and preserves the existing const-reference callback behavior for source-compatible consumers. Downstream binaries must rebuild; binary ABI compatibility is not claimed.
